role: second independent gapless-control experiment for CORR-I

construction.matching: All members satisfy log[C(0)/C(1)]=0.3474 and use t/a=0..10.

purpose: Test whether weak near-zero envelope contraction persists across multiple positive-spectral gapless shapes.
Stress the chamber with p=8, which is gapless but more nearly exponential on the finite t window.
Do not rerun p=1; its result is retained as the previous gapless control reference.
interpretation_boundary: These are synthetic mathematical controls, not Yang-Mills data.
All family members are genuinely gapless because their spectral support reaches E=0.
As p grows, the finite-window correlator becomes increasingly exponential-like even though the exact spectral gap remains zero.
This family therefore probes finite-window discrimination limits of CORR-I.
